welcome.title: Your creative computer, with you in control.
welcome.lede: Start locally. Bring an idea, file, or project. Configure what you want. Nothing runs until you choose Make Production.
welcome.detail: Choose Night or Day Gummy. Start locally without an account; connect more only when you choose.

identity.title: Make this space yours
identity.lede: Your name and private @address identify your personal Actor on this device. Nothing is published, and you can change them later.

box.title: Your Local Gummy Box is ready.
box.lede: It keeps your Productions, Gummies, Returns, and Receipts in this browser. You can export a backup or connect another location later.
box.state: Private on this device · no external account required

starting.title: Choose your first Production
starting.lede: A Production keeps one undertaking—its people, specialists, sources, decisions, results, and history—together.
starting.boundaryTitle: Configure freely. Nothing runs or costs money yet.
starting.boundaryDetail: Make Production is the only step that starts the authorized work shown in its review.
starting.blankDetail: Begin with a private empty workspace and add only what you need.
starting.sampleDetail: Meet the specialist Actors in a safe, no-credential Gummy OS launch example.
starting.optional: Your Local Gummy Box works now. GitHub, Drive, model providers, and local runtimes stay optional.

topics: One durable undertaking: the people and specialist Actors involved, its sources, decisions, Runs, results, and evidence.
A persistent identity or specialist you can open. An Agent is the separate executor that may act for it only with your permission.
What happens when I choose Make Production?
You first see the exact routes, permissions, cost ceiling, and missing capabilities. Only your approval freezes the configuration and starts eligible work.
Where are my results and history?
Results stay as Gummies. Returns explain each attempt, and Receipts preserve what ran, where, under whose authority, and at what cost.
guide.glopper: Ready to explain your Productions, surface pending decisions, navigate results, and propose bounded work.
guide.operator: Optional offline task preparation stays unavailable until you pair a trusted local supervisor.
guide.authority: Master Control shows what may run, which Agent would do it, what it can access, and what it may cost.
guide.unavailable: Missing providers and local runtimes stay visible with an exact explanation. Demonstrations are always labeled.
guide.durability: Your Local Gummy Box keeps Productions, Gummies, Returns, and Receipts in this browser. Export a backup whenever you choose.

presence.intro: Actors are persistent identities and specialists you can open. Agents are separate executors. Availability below describes what this browser can truthfully do now.

cards.name: Glopper
cards.identity: Companion Agent · separate from every Actor
cards.configured: Guidance is available. Approved cloud execution can be proposed with an exact cost ceiling.
cards.capability: Local guidance is available. Cloud execution is not configured, so Glopper will not claim it can run.
cards.truth: Opening Glopper does not start a task.

cards.name: ImageHoss
cards.capability: Visual direction, references, compiled previews, and deterministic studies work now. Real image generation needs the authenticated local ImageHoss and ComfyUI runtime.
cards.truth: Opening ImageHoss only configures it. Real generation is unavailable without the authenticated runtime.

cards.name: VideoBoss
cards.capability: Sequence and shot planning, review, and deterministic takes work now. Real rendering needs a connected server-side provider route.
cards.truth: Opening VideoBoss only configures it. Rendering requires a reviewed route and approval.

cards.name: Meshmallow
cards.capability: World intent, scene planning, mock operations, and package validation work now. Real 3D output needs the authenticated supervisor and supported Blender runtime.
cards.truth: Opening Meshmallow only configures it. Blender does not run until a reviewed Production is approved.

production.boundaryTitle: Configure freely. Nothing runs or costs money yet.
production.boundaryDetail: Opening specialists, assigning sources, and saving settings only prepares this Production. Make Production first shows the exact routes, permissions, locality, and cost ceiling, then starts only the work you approve.

person: Provides direction and Human approval. No Agent authority is implied.
actor:imagehoss: Image direction and deterministic studies are available. Real generation requires the authenticated local runtime.
actor:videoboss: Planning and deterministic takes are available. Real rendering requires a connected provider route.
actor:3d-bee: Scene planning and mock operations are available. Real 3D output requires the authenticated Blender runtime.
actor:project-composer: Assembles accepted Production outputs and evidence without replacing specialist records.
actor:gummy-storage: Preserves sources, results, Returns, and Receipts in the Local Gummy Box.

glopper.configured: Glopper can guide you locally and propose bounded cloud work. Before execution, you see the provider, locality, permission scope, and cost ceiling.
glopper.unconfigured: Glopper can guide and navigate locally. Cloud execution is not configured, so it will not claim that provider work is available.
glopper.emptyResults: Results appear here after an authorized task or Production finishes. Creating and configuring a Production does not execute anything.
